data_fields.name: reward_payment
data_fields.donor_constant: per-action payment value; a negative payment is clamped so the balance never goes below zero (GameAction.cpp 459-462)

data_fields.name: objective_condition
data_fields.donor_constant: no fixed number in the donor; completion requires a ConditionSet test to pass (Mission.cpp 1113)

data_fields.name: missing_condition_value
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 (a missing ledger name reads as zero)

data_fields.name: integer_range
data_fields.donor_constant: int64; add, subtract and multiply have no overflow check (ConditionAssignments.cpp:110, 113, 116); divide by zero writes int64 max (line 119)

best_idea: Quest state is counters in one ledger ('<quest>: offered / active / done / failed'), completion is an AND over objective checks, and a reward runs only when its own gate passes, so only a gate-passing trigger moves the counters (fail and abort are the exception).
decision_why: Keep the counter lifecycle and the AND completion predicate, with counters written only by the server; drop the free-form expression language for now; add the objective check inside the server's complete path (the donor's Do does not check it); clamp integer writes and refuse division by zero.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a client-sent COMPLETE is refused while a bounty's kill count is below three, that a completed bounty pays once, and that a negative payment never takes credits below zero.
